=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: scripts/render_prompt.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 193-198 (the `extract_identity_recall_metadata` Python heredoc skip-logic)
  Problem: The first-paragraph collector skips empty lines, `#` comment lines, and `{%...%}` Jinja directives, but does NOT skip XML-style blocks such as `<compaction-rules>...</compaction-rules>`. When `UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true` and `PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED=false` (the default rollout state), `resolve_identity_source_prompt` returns the legacy `prompts/mode-*.txt` file directly. Those files now start with the `<compaction-rules>` block inserted by the implement step. The collector absorbs the entire multi-line block as the first paragraph, so `paragraph` contains `<compaction-rules>If you compact context: - Preserve the latest file-read result... - Preserve the exact structured-output contract... - When UNATTENDED_TRANSCRIPT_ARCHIVE_ENABLED=true...</compaction-rules>` and the regex `re.match(r"^Role:\s*(?P<role>.+?)\s+Goal:\s*(?P<goal>.+?)\s*$", paragraph)` fails.
  Why it fails at runtime: `sys.exit(1)` fires, the caller catches this as `metadata_extract_failed`, and `emit_identity_reinject_parse_fail` logs `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL: mode-<phase> reason=metadata_extract_failed`. Identity-recall injection silently stops working for all 28 legacy prompt modes. The `<identity-recall>` block is never injected into the rendered prompt. This breaks the Phase B contract for any consumer that sets `UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true` without also enabling the prelude refactor.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- File: scripts/render_prompt.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 192-205 (the Python heredoc inside `extract_identity_recall_metadata()`)
  Problem: The skip predicate on line 198 (`if not line or line.startswith("#") or (line.startswith("{%") and line.endswith("%}"))`) correctly ignores blank lines, `#`-prefixed comments, and Jinja `{% ... %}` directives, but does not skip the injected `<compaction-rules>...</compaction-rules>` XML-like block that now appears at the top of every legacy prompt updated by this PR. Because the block is not on a single line, the loop absorbs every line inside `<compaction-rules>` into `paragraph_lines`. The paragraph then begins with `<compaction-rules> If you compact context: ...` instead of the `Role: ... Goal: ...` sentence, so the `re.match(r"^Role:...")` on line 206 fails and `sys.exit(1)` fires.
  Why it fails at runtime: When `UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true` and `PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED=false` (the default rollout state), `render_prompt.sh` calls `extract_identity_recall_metadata` on each legacy prompt to derive `PHASE_ROLE` and `PHASE_MISSION` for the identity-recall injection. Any prompt whose first non-blank, non-comment, non-Jinja content is the multi-line `<compaction-rules>` block will now fail the metadata extraction. The caller logs `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL: mode-<X> reason=metadata_extract_failed`, the identity-recall block is not injected, and the prompt runs without the `<identity-recall>` preamble — breaking `tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh` for every affected mode. This is the default path (legacy prompts, prelude refactor off), so it is the most common deployment scenario.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
